label: Updated Lex30 - written easy-cue pilot v0.2
instructions: You will see 30 English words. For each word, type up to 4 words that come to your mind. Press SPACE to go to the next word at any time, or wait 30 seconds and it will move on automatically.

selectionMetadata.cueDifficultyPolicy: All stimulus cues must be NJ8 K1 with rank <= 1000.
selectionMetadata.selectionRule: Recommended audio candidates only; original Lex30 cues excluded; cross-list band mismatch, psycholinguistic review flags, abstract suffixes, word length, NJ8 rank, and stable hash used for deterministic ordering.
selectionMetadata.reviewWarning: This is a draft candidate set, not a validated final Updated Lex30 stimulus set.
